title: Super informative and super fun!
text: Emili taught us to sketch and watercolour-paint during a jazz jam session at a local jazz bar. It was also just our luck that that night, some of the hidden musical gems in town decided to show up and share their talents on stage! It all added to the atmosphere of the painting session - if not enhancing each other. Emili is a professional, articulate, helpful, kind, supportive, talented, conscious, and objective teacher. As a complete beginner, his session was both highly informative and extremely enjoyable. I'm definitely joining again; he has inspired me to keep practicing and exploring sket
author: fatemanuar

title: Excellent fun and relaxing watercolor workshop
text: I did a watercolor afternoon in the Ciutadella park and loved it! Emili carries the material and gives tips to make the best watercolor, leaving the freedom to flow your style and what you want to draw. The Mood was both fun and relaxing, I had a great time! I recommend it 100% to get to know Barcelona better and discover the watercolor!
